rows.description: US Government official website banner with Veterans Crisis Line CTA

elements.label: An official website of the United States government
Here's how you know
elements.clickBehavior: expands to show .gov and https security explanations with icons

elements.label: Talk to the Veterans Crisis Line now
elements.clickBehavior: opens modal dialog with crisis contact options (call 988, text 838255, chat, TTY). Modal has semi-transparent dark overlay backdrop.

rows.description: VA brand identity with utility links (Search, Contact us, Sign in)

elements.label: VA logo and Seal, U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs
Search
elements.hoverBehavior: subtle border highlight around search area
elements.clickBehavior: expands dropdown with search text input and search submit button; chevron flips up when expanded

elements.label: Sign in
elements.hoverBehavior: subtle background change on blue button

rows.description: Main navigation bar with 2 dropdown menus and 3 direct links
rows.spacing: distributed with gap between left group and right group

elements.label: VA Benefits and Health Care
elements.clickBehavior: opens multi-level megamenu: left sidebar with 9 expandable categories (Health care, Disability, Education and training, Careers and employment, Pension, Housing assistance, Life insurance, Burials and memorials, Records) and 2 direct links (Service members, Family and caregivers). Clicking a category expands right panel with grouped links and promotional card.

elements.label: About VA
elements.clickBehavior: opens full-width megamenu panel with 3 columns (VA organizations - 7 links, Innovation at VA - 7 links, Learn about VA - 6 links) and a right promotional card (Agency Financial Report with paper icon image)

notes: No hamburger icon is visible at desktop viewport (1440px) - appears only on mobile
No locale/language selector in the header - language assistance links (Español, Tagalog, Other languages) exist in the footer only
Search is in Row 1 as an expandable dropdown triggered by button click
Row 0 has split background: left area is light gray gov banner, right area is dark red/maroon crisis line banner
Row 1 has dark blue background (#162E51) with VA logo on left and utilities on right
Row 2 has lighter blue background with main navigation items
VA Benefits and Health Care has a unique 2-level megamenu: category sidebar on left + content panel on right
About VA has a simpler megamenu: direct 3-column layout + promotional card
Veterans Crisis Line opens a modal with semi-transparent overlay backdrop
